simple.meaning: שְׁמִטָּה (shᵉmiṭṭâh) is a Hebrew word meaning “remission (of debt) or suspension of labor).” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: שְׁמִטָּה (H8059) appears 5 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Deuteronomy 15:1, with occurrences in Deuteronomy.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to שְׁמִטָּה (H8059) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in שְׁמִטָּה (H8059) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: שְׁמִטָּה (shᵉmiṭṭâh) / H8059 is traced through Deuteronomy 15:1, Deuteronomy 15:2, Deuteronomy 15:9, Deuteronomy 31:10 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.

timeline.evidenceText: At the end of every seven years, you shall cancel debts.
